title: Loading full ActiveRecord objects for scalar data
summary: Fetching complete model objects when only IDs or scalar fields are needed wastes memory, CPU, and database bandwidth.
rationale: ActiveRecord object hydration is convenient but expensive for large result sets or simple reporting paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large collections, high-traffic Rails actions, background jobs, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use pluck, pick, ids, select with limited columns, or database-side aggregation when full model behavior is not needed.
remediation.tradeoffs: May require refactoring for readability, query shape, or framework conventions.
